user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Successfully request password reset with a valid email
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with a valid email address in the email field.
Check the response code and message.
positive.expected_result: Response code 200 and a success message indicating that a password reset link has been sent.

negative.title: Fail to request password reset with an empty email field
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an empty email field.
Check the response code and message.
negative.expected_result: Response code 400 and an error message indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Fail to request password reset with an invalid email format
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an invalid email address (e.g., 'user@.com').
Check the response code and message.
edge.expected_result: Response code 400 and an error message indicating that the email format is invalid.
